title: PasswordReset does not work for Accu-Check Spirit Combo
symptom: After creating a PasswordReset file in AAPS/extra folder and restarting the app, the file disappears and a message says password was set, but the master password is not the pump serial number, so login fails.
evidence_quote: I copied a "PasswordReset" empty file to AAPS/extra folder, restarted APPS application, file got droped, saw a popup message saying that password got changed, but then I when enter insulin pump serial number, it says that password is not correct.
